map.📖 查看「网络（宽带/安装）推荐 使用指南」: 📖 View the User Guide for Network (Broadband / Installation) Recommendation
map.宽带带宽按人数与用途推荐：1 至 2 人日常上网 50 至 100 Mbps、3: Broadband bandwidth is recommended by number of users and usage: 1–2 people daily surfing 50–100 Mbps, 3–4 people multi-device and HD video 200–300 Mbps, 4+ people or 4K and gaming 500–1000 Mbps; actual usable bandwidth ≈ nominal bandwidth × (1 − line loss 10%–20%) ÷ simultaneously online devices; equipment essentials include gigabit optical modem, WiFi 6 dual-band router (2.4G and 5G) and Cat-5e or better cable; before installation verify whether the community is already covered.
map.📚 深度解析：宽带带宽与安装要点速查: 📚 Deep Dive: Broadband Bandwidth and Installation Quick Reference
map.租房或搬家前快速列出几种典型用网场景对应的带宽档位与接入方式，作为选购对照。: Before renting or moving, quickly list the bandwidth tiers and access methods for several typical network scenarios, as a purchase reference.
map.和运营商沟通前先看一遍常见安装注意项（光猫押金、合约期、违约金、高峰期稳定性）。: Before talking to the operator, review common installation notes (modem deposit, contract period, early-termination penalty, peak-hour stability).
map.给合租室友或家人解释为什么需要某个档位，用场景而不是参数沟通。: Explain to co-tenants or family why a certain tier is needed, communicating by scenario rather than parameters.
map.生成结果长什么样: What does the generated result look like
map.设定生成数量后，工具逐条输出\"使用场景 — 推荐带宽 + 接入类型\"并附一条: After setting the generation count, the tool outputs line by line "usage scenario — recommended bandwidth + access type" with one installation tip, e.g. "home remote work — recommended 500M fiber to the home (FTTH) / installation tip: watch the contract period and early-termination penalty". Scenarios, bandwidth tiers, access types and tips are all sampled from common combinations, so the same setting generates different entries each time.
map.为什么没有让我输入人数和户型？: Why does it not ask me to enter the number of users and unit type?
map.本工具是速查清单，只按你设定的条数从常见场景组合中取样，不做按人数/面积的带宽推: This tool is a quick-reference list; it only samples from common scenario combinations by the count you set, and does not compute bandwidth by number of users/area. When you need a precise estimate by device count, accumulate yourself per "about 25 Mbps per 4K stream, about 4 Mbps per video conference".
map.推荐结果能当运营商报价吗？: Can the recommendation be used as an operator quote?
map.不能。它不包含任何实时资费与覆盖信息，仅用于对照选购；实际套餐价格、安装费与覆盖: No. It contains no real-time tariff or coverage information, and is for purchase comparison only; for actual plan prices, installation fees and coverage, please refer to your local operator.
map.网络（宽带/安装）推荐。免费在线工具，纯前端处理，数据不上传，保护隐私安全。: Network (Broadband / Installation) Recommendation. Free online tool, processed entirely in the browser, no data uploaded, your privacy and security protected.
map.按人数、用途与户型推荐宽带带宽与套餐，提示安装与设备要点，用于选购参考，纯前端建: Recommends broadband bandwidth and plans by household size, usage, and layout, with installation and equipment notes for reference only.
map.需求带宽估算 =（基础 50 Mbps + 人数 × 10 Mbps + 同时在: Estimated demand = (base 50 Mbps + people × 10 Mbps + concurrent devices × 5 Mbps) × usage factor. Factors: daily 1.0, remote work 1.5, 4K 2.0, gaming 2.0, live upload 3.0, smart home 1.2. The recommended range starts at the smallest tier at least 1.2× the estimate and shows the next tier as headroom. Nominal bandwidth is derated to 85% usable (about 15% line loss), then shared across concurrent devices. Coverage is one router, two-node mesh or three-node mesh by floor area. Rules are fixed, so identical inputs give identical results; live prices and address coverage are not verified.
map.📚 深度解析：按需求规则推荐宽带与覆盖: 📚 Deep Dive: Rule-Based Broadband and Coverage Recommendations
map.租房或搬家前输入人数、同时在线设备、主要用途与面积，得到带宽区间、每设备可用带宽: Before renting or moving, enter household size, concurrent devices, main usage and area to get a bandwidth range, per-device usable bandwidth, router/ONT and coverage advice.
map.同一组输入反复查看结果稳定，便于和家人、室友或运营商沟通同一套需求。: The same inputs always give the same result, so you can discuss one consistent requirement with family, roommates or the ISP.
map.把结果当作选购对照，不当作地址覆盖或实时资费的确认；下单前仍需运营商勘测。: Use it as a buying comparison, not confirmation of address coverage or live prices; the ISP still needs to survey before ordering.
map.估算需求 =（50 + 3×10 + 6×5）×1.0 = 110 Mbps；留: Estimated demand = (50 + 3×10 + 6×5)×1.0 = 110 Mbps; with 1.2× headroom → 132 Mbps, choose the smallest tier at least that value, 200 Mbps, and show 300 Mbps as the range. Usable at the lower tier is 85% of nominal = 170 Mbps, about 28.3 Mbps per device for six devices. For 90 m², use a Wi-Fi 6 dual-band router plus a gigabit ONT; the same inputs give the same result.
map.为什么结果不再每次不同？: Why is the result no longer different each time?
map.旧版从场景、带宽、接入方式和建议中独立随机抽取，无法按实际人数或设备推荐。新版改: The old version randomly drew scenario, bandwidth, access type and advice independently, so it could not recommend by actual people or devices. The new version uses fixed rules, so identical inputs always give the same result for review and discussion.
map.推荐带宽能当运营商套餐吗？: Is the recommended bandwidth an ISP plan?
map.不能。工具不包含实时资费、安装费与地址覆盖信息；推荐区间只是需求估算，实际可选套: No. It excludes live prices, installation fees and address coverage; the range is only a demand estimate. Actual plans and speeds depend on the ISP survey and published terms.
map.设备数应该怎么填？: How should device count be filled?
map.填同时在线的最坏情况设备数，而不是家里设备总数。低档每设备分摊 = 标称带宽×8: Enter the worst-case number of concurrent devices, not the total at home. Per-device share at the lower tier = nominal bandwidth×85% ÷ concurrent devices; if peak-hour congestion is severe, choose a higher tier or improve cabling.
map.规则固定，同一输入结果稳定，不再随机抽取场景组合: Fixed rules, stable results, no random scenario combinations
map.标称带宽按 85% 折算可用带宽，再按同时在线设备分摊: Nominal bandwidth derated to 85%, then shared across concurrent devices
map.无法离线确认地址覆盖与实时资费，请以运营商勘测和公示为准: Address coverage and live prices cannot be confirmed offline; rely on the ISP survey and published plans
map.按人数、同时在线设备、用途与面积，用固定规则给出带宽区间、设备与覆盖建议；不确认: Use fixed rules on household size, concurrent devices, usage and area to recommend bandwidth, equipment and coverage; no address or live-plan verification.
map.同一输入结果稳定可复核: Stable, reviewable results for identical inputs
